notes: Creativity was held at 3 rather than 4 because the provided text gives no XBOX revenue, user or customer figures, although XBOX is a named product line within the More Personal Computing segment. 'Billions of people' describes the market, not company reach, so it was not used as an indicator. XBOX also enables third-party developers and 'new content creators' through Game Pass and digital stores; this was not recorded separately to avoid double counting within Creativity, and it was judged too nonspecific for Entrepreneurship. 'Accessible on XBOX consoles' refers to device availability, not disability accessibility, so it was not counted. The Item 7 excerpt (OpenAI partnership) contains no qualifying activity; 'partnership' and 'accessible' there are trap usages. Trap terms ignored: 'collaboration' meaning software products, 'licensing' of patents, 'design' of devices, 'content' meaning advertising or web content, 'community' meaning external development community, and small niche businesses mentioned as competitors. The Sustainability Report reference covers environmental goals only, so it does not trigger insufficient coverage.
